intent_en: Compare the U.S. vegan population share in 2008 and 2014 and report the female share of U.S. vegans.
narration_support: As of Pulse taken in 2014, vegans now make up roughly 2 .5 % ... women seem to be far bigger fans of veganism
chart_support: Infographic displaying text labels for vegan population percentages in the US in 2008 and 2014, and the percentage of vegans who are female, alongside an illustration of a woman.
evidence_note: Narration discusses 2014 US vegan population and female majority; chart visualizes the increase from 2008 to 2014 in the US and the 79% female statistic.
narrative_goal: Show that the U.S. vegan population grew from 0.5% in 2008 to 2.5% in 2014, with women making up 79% of U.S. vegans.
current_model_input: Compare the U.S. vegan population share in 2008 and 2014 and report the female share of U.S. vegans.
